description: This file contains a PHP class definition for managing 'menu' entities within the OpenCart admin module. It provides methods for creating, reading, updating, and deleting menu records and their descriptions in the database, supporting multi-language descriptions and hierarchical submenus.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: A class for managing menu items in the OpenCart admin module, including CRUD operations and description management.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Creates a new menu record in the database with data provided, including handling descriptions in multiple languages.

methods.name: editMenu
methods.description: Updates an existing menu record identified by menu_id with new data and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteMenu
methods.description: Deletes a menu by its ID, updates submenus' parent references, and removes descriptions.

methods.name: deleteMenuByCode
methods.description: Deletes menus based on their code by retrieving all matching entries and removing each.

methods.name: getMenu
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific menu by its ID, including descriptions for current language.

methods.name: getMenuByCode
methods.description: Retrieves menu details by code, including descriptions for current language.

methods.name: getMenus
methods.description: Retrieves all menus, indexed by their code, ordered by sort order.

methods.name: getTotalMenus
methods.description: Returns the total count of menu entries in the database.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a specific menu in a given language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions associated with a given menu ID.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for menus in a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a menu, organized by language ID.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all menu descriptions in a specific language.
